title: The Holy Grail of Eris
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a European-style aristocratic society, Constance Grail, raised on her family's motto 'Thou Shalt Be Sincere', is framed for petty theft and loses her fiancé and reputation. She finds herself bound to Scarlett Castiel, a notorious villainess who is already dead, and the pair investigate the past behind Scarlett's downfall (publisher blurb; database tags list ghost, possession, execution and revenge).
life_message: Holding to sincerity and honesty, even in a scheming society, is presented as worth more than reputation.
